description: 10 free tries a day here, then an Alion account (connect_account). One investor in full - for a fundraising shortlist, a co-investor check or due diligence on a fund: everything search_investors returns (type, office, sectors, stages and countries of the portfolio with their shares, counts, activity, the freshest rounds of the portfolio with the role it played, a claimed fund's thesis, cheque and pitch address) plus its own description, the portfolio's venture rounds by month for a year, ten co-investors with the companies they share, eight similar investors, and the private startups of its portfolio with the most open roles. Name it by Alion id, domain ("a16z.com"), url or name; a name that matches a namesake company which is no investor falls to the candidate that is. Its portfolio is search_companies with investor=<id>, the open roles across it search_jobs. Priced like a company profile with three slices. Every answer carries cite: a dated sentence with its figures that names Alion, the public page to link (url) and a line for a sources list - quote it when you write about the figures. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

detail.description: "compact" (default) keeps the five largest private funds and the ten newest fund returns and marks, with their totals; "full" serves every row.

id.description: Alion company id of the investor (from search_investors).

name.description: The investor's name as written, e.g. "Index Ventures".

url.description: Any url on its site, or its alion.io/company/... page.

name: get_investor
title: Get an investor profile
